basic_info.description: Stylish 1BD/1BA condo just 1 block from iconic Haight Street, offering in-unit laundry, private storage, and leased on-site 1-car parking. Set in a classic 1895 Victorian, this home blends historic charm with modern functionality featuring 11-ft ceilings, hardwood floors, stained glass windows, wainscoting, and transom details. The living room feels airy and serene, with treetop views and enough space for both lounging and working. The eat-in kitchen is updated with warm wood cabinetry, updated countertops, and stainless steel appliances including a gas range. The bedroom is tucked at the back of the unit, comfortably fits a queen bed, and includes ample storage. A spa-inspired bathroom features a walk-in shower, custom vanity, and heated river-pebble flooring. Thoughtful design includes three unshared walls and an insulated crawl space above for enhanced privacy. Walk Score 98. Just steps to Whole Foods, Bi-Rite, Zazie, and four parks including Golden Gate Park only four blocks away. Easy access to MUNI and N-line.
